decision_conditions: <p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, within three&nbsp;(3) months of the date of the permission herein granted,&nbsp;details of privacy screening along the raised platform and steps, which shall be 1.8m above the adjacent level of the steps/platform, shall be&nbsp;submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority.</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the amenity of existing and neighbouring occupiers,&nbsp;in accordance with Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and Policy D3 The London Plan (2021).</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
